name: Norn workforce canon handles: time, organization, full HR, payroll, talent, and W3C DPV PII primitives

mappings.justification: W3C ORG org:OrganizationalUnit (canonical RDF IRI http://www.w3.org/ns/org#OrganizationalUnit; HTTPS form required by Norn ontology_pack checker).
W3C ORG org:Post (canonical RDF IRI http://www.w3.org/ns/org#Post; HTTPS form required by Norn ontology_pack checker).
W3C ORG org:Membership (canonical RDF IRI http://www.w3.org/ns/org#Membership; HTTPS form required by Norn ontology_pack checker).
OWL-Time time:TRS paired with pinned IANA tzdb policy (canonical RDF IRI http://www.w3.org/2006/time#TRS; HTTPS form required by Norn ontology_pack checker).
W3C DPV 2.1 Personal Data extension class dpv-pd:Salary covers salary, compensation, and pay amounts.
W3C DPV 2.1 dpv-pd:OfficialID covers national IDs, passports, and government-issued identifiers (proposed close_match pending human ratification).
W3C DPV 2.1 dpv-pd:Demographic covers birth date and demographic attributes; employee contact fields (phone, address) overlap dpv-pd:Contact.
W3C DPV 2.1 dpv-pd:Biometric covers biometric templates and kiosk verification photos (proposed close_match pending human ratification).
W3C DPV 2.1 dpv-pd:Health covers employee sick leave documentation and medical fitness records.
W3C DPV 2.1 dpv-pd:PerformanceAtWork covers employee appraisals, ratings, and disciplinary records.
HR Open 4.5R WorkerType captures employment relationship, assignment, and status metadata.
HR Open 4.5R TimecardType captures worked time intervals, allowances, and shift reconciliation.
HR Open 4.5R PayrollType captures payroll earnings, deductions, withholdings, and net pay instructions.
HR Open 4.5R PositionOpeningType captures job requisitions, posting profiles, and position requirements.

terms.definition: A pinned IANA timezone and DST resolution calendar governing local wall-clock schedules.
terms.label: Calendar

terms.definition: A public holiday, blackout date, or working-day override attached to a calendar.
terms.label: Calendar exception

terms.definition: A recurring local wall-clock operating window materialized to canonical UTC intervals.
terms.label: Working window

terms.definition: A natural person participating in organizational memberships and employment relationships (implements core.Agent).
terms.label: Person

terms.definition: A branch, department, workshop, or team within an organization (W3C ORG OrganizationalUnit, implements core.Agent).
terms.label: Organizational unit

terms.definition: A budgeted role or position within an organizational unit that can be vacant or filled over time (W3C ORG Post).
terms.label: Post

terms.definition: A time-bounded relationship binding a person to an organizational unit and optional post (W3C ORG Membership, implements core.AgentRole).
terms.label: Membership

terms.definition: Effective-dated employment terms governing an agent's work membership with an employer unit.
terms.label: Employment

terms.definition: A conserved stock of earned leave entitlement days held for an employee (implements core.Resource).
terms.label: Leave balance

terms.definition: An exact decimal quantity of leave days allocated, reserved, or consumed in UCUM days.
terms.label: Leave quantity

terms.definition: A governed request by an employee to consume leave over a date interval.
terms.label: Leave request

terms.definition: Approve a pending leave request under independent manager authority and debit the conserved leave balance.
terms.label: Approve leave request

terms.definition: A promised labor shift assigned to an employee over a half-open UTC interval (implements core.Commitment).
terms.label: Shift commitment

terms.definition: An immutable posted work event fulfilling a shift commitment (implements core.EconomicEvent).
terms.label: Attendance event

terms.definition: A leave request exceeds the employee's remaining available leave balance.
terms.label: Insufficient leave balance

terms.definition: A leave request overlaps an existing active or approved leave interval for the same employee.
terms.label: Overlapping leave request

terms.definition: Two scheduled shifts for the same employee overlap in time.
terms.label: Overlapping shift commitment

terms.definition: The gap between two consecutive shifts for an employee is below the governed statutory rest floor.
terms.label: Minimum rest violation

terms.definition: A requester attempts to approve their own leave, payroll, expense, or roster exception.
terms.label: Self-approval forbidden

terms.definition: A typed earning, deduction, tax withholding, or employer statutory contribution rule (HR Open Payroll).
terms.label: Pay component

terms.definition: A named template composing pay components and calculation formulas for an employee grade or cohort.
terms.label: Compensation structure

terms.definition: Effective-dated assignment binding an employee to a compensation structure and base pay rate.
terms.label: Compensation assignment

terms.definition: A closed accounting and pay calendar interval governing payslip accrual and cutoffs.
terms.label: Payroll period

terms.definition: A governed batch cycle calculating, approving under SoD, and disbursing payslips for a payroll period.
terms.label: Payroll run

terms.definition: An employee pay statement for one payroll period (implements canon.ItemizedDocument; HR Open Payroll).
terms.label: Payslip

terms.definition: One itemized earning, deduction, tax, or benefit line on a payslip (implements canon.LineItem).
terms.label: Payslip line

terms.definition: An approved bonus, penalty, allowance, or salary advance adjustment applied to a payroll period.
terms.label: Off-cycle payroll adjustment

terms.definition: A receipt-authenticated salary or claim transfer instruction settling a payslip (implements canon.Settlement; ISO 20022 pain.001 / camt.053).
terms.label: Payout disbursement

terms.definition: A governed category of leave (annual, sick, unpaid, maternity, compensatory) with carry-forward and encashment flags.
terms.label: Leave type

terms.definition: Statutory and company entitlement rules assigning annual leave allocations by tenure or grade.
terms.label: Leave policy

terms.definition: A periodic grant crediting a conserved leave balance for an employee over a leave period.
terms.label: Leave allocation

terms.definition: An immutable conserved credit or debit posting on an employee leave balance (implements core.LedgerEffect).
terms.label: Leave ledger entry

terms.definition: A request converting verified holiday or rest-day work into a conserved leave balance credit.
terms.label: Compensatory leave request

terms.definition: A governed conversion of unused encashable leave balance into a payroll earning adjustment.
terms.label: Leave encashment

terms.definition: A reusable local wall-clock shift definition with optional overnight end-day offset (extends norn.time.working.window).
terms.label: Shift template

terms.definition: A multi-day branch schedule lifecycle combining solver proposals (FunctionReceipt) and manager overrides.
terms.label: Roster schedule

terms.definition: A declarative hard or soft rostering constraint (coverage floor, safe departure, availability, pairing, rest floor).
terms.label: Scheduling constraint

terms.definition: A raw kiosk, biometric, or mobile punch observation prior to reconciliation into a posted attendance event.
terms.label: Check-in observation

terms.definition: A governed correction or excuse request for missed punches, lateness, or work-from-home days.
terms.label: Attendance exception

terms.definition: Cash advanced to an employee pending reconciliation against expense claims or payroll recovery (implements core.Claim).
terms.label: Employee advance

terms.definition: An employee reimbursement claim backed by receipts and independent manager approval (implements canon.ItemizedDocument).
terms.label: Expense claim

terms.definition: One categorized receipt-backed expense item on an expense claim (implements canon.LineItem).
terms.label: Expense claim line

terms.definition: A conserved principal balance lent to an employee with scheduled payroll withholding (implements core.Claim).
terms.label: Employee loan

terms.definition: Scheduled installment postings reducing an employee loan principal via payroll deduction or direct settlement.
terms.label: Loan repayment schedule

terms.definition: An approved vacancy recruiting against a budgeted org.Post (HR Open PositionOpening).
terms.label: Job opening

terms.definition: A candidate applying to one or more job openings with PII-classified contact and CV records.
terms.label: Job applicant

terms.definition: A scheduled structured evaluation event between interviewers and a job applicant.
terms.label: Interview

terms.definition: A formal conditional employment and compensation offer issued to a selected applicant.
terms.label: Job offer

terms.definition: A governed checklist plan transitioning an accepted offer into an active org.Membership.
terms.label: Employee onboarding

terms.definition: An effective-dated transfer, branch reassignment, or promotion updating org.Membership and compensation.
terms.label: Employment change

terms.definition: An offboarding and contract termination workflow closing active memberships and access.
terms.label: Employee separation

terms.definition: Terminal payout combining prorated salary, statutory gratuity, leave encashment, and loan recovery.
terms.label: Full and final settlement

terms.definition: A canonical occupation skill, license, or safety certification (aligns with ESCO / ISCO-08 / O*NET).
terms.label: Skill or qualification

terms.definition: An attested proficiency or time-bounded certification held by an employee (used by skill-qualified rostering).
terms.label: Employee skill attestation

terms.definition: A measurable key result area or objective assigned to an employee for an appraisal cycle.
terms.label: Performance goal

terms.definition: A periodic performance review evaluating goals and competencies (ISO 30414 human capital reporting).
terms.label: Performance appraisal

terms.definition: A scheduled learning or compliance training session for employees.
terms.label: Training event

terms.definition: An employee completion record and assessment outcome for a training event.
terms.label: Training result

terms.definition: Jurisdiction-scoped progressive income tax brackets and exemption rules (ISO 3166-1 country overlay).
terms.label: Income tax slab

terms.definition: End-of-service indemnity calculation governed by national labor statute.
terms.label: Statutory gratuity

terms.definition: Canonical data-classification marking for salary, bonus, bank account, and payslip amounts (W3C DPV 2.1 dpv-pd:Salary).
terms.label: HR PII: Compensation

terms.definition: Canonical marking for national ID, passport, tax ID, and social insurance numbers (W3C DPV 2.1 dpv-pd:OfficialID).
terms.label: HR PII: Government ID

terms.definition: Canonical marking for personal phone, home address, gender, and date of birth (W3C DPV 2.1 dpv-pd:Demographic).
terms.label: HR PII: Demographic

terms.definition: Canonical marking for kiosk selfie hashes, face/fingerprint templates (W3C DPV 2.1 dpv-pd:Biometric).
terms.label: HR PII: Biometric

terms.definition: Canonical marking for sick-leave certificates and occupational health records (W3C DPV 2.1 dpv-pd:Health).
terms.label: HR PII: Medical and sick leave

terms.definition: Canonical marking for appraisal scores and disciplinary records (W3C DPV 2.1 dpv-pd:JobPerformance).
terms.label: HR PII: Performance and disciplinary

terms.definition: Payslip net pay does not equal gross earnings minus lawful deductions.
terms.label: Payslip arithmetic conservation violated

terms.definition: A payout settlement transition lacks a verified FunctionReceipt from a pinned payment performer.
terms.label: Unauthenticated payout settlement

terms.definition: Payroll deductions exceed gross earnings without clamping net pay to zero and carrying forward debt.
terms.label: Negative net pay forbidden

terms.definition: A scheduled shift finishes past an employee's active safe-departure local time ceiling.
terms.label: Safe departure cutoff exceeded
